docs.label: API
docs.title: The zerosoft API.
docs.intro: Link, CRM, Cal and Agents expose a REST API with JSON responses and personal keys.
docs.authDesc: Every request needs an API key, sent as a Bearer token. For browser sessions the Google OAuth flow creates the session cookie.
docs.authNote: Create keys in Dashboard → Settings → API keys. A key is shown exactly once: copy it and store it like a password. Each key allows 100 requests per minute.
docs.linksDesc: Create, list, update and measure short links.
docs.authFlowDesc: Redirect the user to start the Google OAuth flow. After success they return to the app with a session cookie.
docs.linksCreateDesc: Creates a short link with the same options as the app: UTM, expiration, click limit, password, social preview, targeting and an externalId. slug is optional: leave it out and we generate one.
docs.linksListDesc: Your links, newest first. Paginate with page and pageSize (max 100).
docs.linksDeleteDesc: Delete a link by id, along with its click history. The person who created the API key must be a workspace admin.
docs.linksPatchDesc: Update any writable field of a link.
docs.linksStatsDesc: Click totals and a per-day breakdown for one link.
docs.linksAnalyticsDesc: Clicks and QR scans across all your links in a range: per day, top links, referrers, countries, devices and browsers. Up to 366 days.
docs.contactsListDesc: List contacts. Filters: q, page, pageSize (max 100).
docs.contactsPatchDesc: Update any property of a contact.
docs.companiesListDesc: List companies. Filters: q, page, pageSize.
docs.companiesPatchDesc: Update any property of a company.
docs.dealsCreateDesc: Create a deal in a pipeline stage.
docs.tasksListDesc: List tasks. bucket: overdue, today, upcoming, done.
docs.tasksCreateDesc: Create a task, optionally linked to a record.
docs.stagesCreateDesc: Create a stage inside a pipeline.
docs.teamsInviteDesc: Invite an email to join a team.
docs.teamsSwitchDesc: Switch active workspace. Use teamId: null for the personal workspace.
docs.docsPatchDesc: Update title, content or archive a page.
docs.paramLinkId: Link id, or ext_ followed by the externalId you set when creating it.
docs.paramFrom: Start date (YYYY-MM-DD). Defaults to 29 days ago.
docs.paramLinkTargeting: Country and device rules, weighted A/B destinations and iOS/Android deep links. null clears them.
docs.paramTaskBucket: Filter bucket: overdue, today, upcoming, done.
docs.paramTeamIdSwitch: Team id or null for the personal workspace.
docs.calDesc: Event types and bookings. Bookings created through the API follow the same rules as the public page (availability, buffers, Google Calendar busy times) and send the same emails.
docs.calEventTypesDesc: Your event types with their public booking URL.
docs.calBookingsListDesc: Bookings of your event types, newest first. Filter by status and date range.
docs.calBookingsCreateDesc: Books a slot for a guest. Returns 409 slot_unavailable if the time isn't offered anymore.
docs.calBookingsGetDesc: One booking by id (event type owner or assigned host).
docs.calBookingsCancelDesc: Cancels a confirmed booking, emails the guest a cancellation with .ics, removes the Google Calendar event and emits booking.cancelled.
docs.calBookingsRescheduleDesc: Moves a confirmed booking to another offered time, emails the guest the updated .ics and emits booking.rescheduled. Returns 409 slot_unavailable if that time is not offered.
docs.calBookingsNoShowDesc: Marks that the guest did not show up. Confirmed bookings only.
docs.agentsDesc: Talk to your AI agents from your own app. The agent uses the same instructions, knowledge and tools as in Chat and on its public page; every reply counts toward the workspace AI quota.
docs.agentsMessagesTitle: Send a message to an agent
docs.agentsMessagesDesc: Returns the agent's reply and the tools it used. Send the returned conversationId to continue the same conversation. Errors: 404 not_found, 403 agent_disabled, 429 rate_limited, 503 ai_disabled.
docs.robotsDesc: Run your browser robots from your own app, one at a time or over many inputs. Runs go through the same queue as in the app (one at a time per workspace) and count toward the monthly robot minutes. Running needs a key created by a workspace admin.
docs.robotsListDesc: Returns the workspace robots with their inputs, so you know what to send when running them.
docs.robotsRunDesc: Queues a run and returns 202 with the run; poll GET /api/v1/robots/runs/:id until status is success or failed. With "wait": true the response waits for the result (200) when no other run is ahead. The robot needs automatic runs turned on. Errors: 404 not_found, 400 missing_input or disabled, 409 busy, 429 rate_limited or quota_exceeded, 503 runner_unavailable.
docs.robotsRunGetDesc: Status, inputs and extracted data of a run. changed tells whether the data differs from the previous successful run with the same inputs (null when there was nothing to compare).
docs.robotsBulkTitle: Run a robot over many inputs
docs.robotsBulkDesc: Queues one run per item of inputs (up to 1,000) under a batch id. Runs start one after another; every input is validated before anything is queued. Errors: 400 missing_input (with the item index), 409 busy, 429 rate_limited.
docs.robotsBatchGetDesc: Counts by status, done when every run finished, and the input, output and error of each run in the order you sent them.
docs.paramAgentMessage: What the user says (up to 4000 characters).
docs.paramAgentConversationId: Continue an existing API conversation. Omit it to start a new one.
docs.paramRobotInputs: Robot inputs by name. List inputs take an array of strings.
docs.paramRobotWait: Wait for the result in the same response (up to the robot timeout). Default false.
docs.paramRobotBulkInputs: One inputs object per run, 1 to 1,000.
docs.webhooksDesc: Add endpoints in Dashboard → Settings → Webhooks. Events: booking.created, booking.rescheduled, booking.cancelled, booking.no_show, booking.requested, link.created, link.clicked, link.updated, link.deleted, contact.created, contact.updated, deal.created, deal.updated, deal.stage_changed, deal.won, deal.lost, robot.run.finished, robot.run.failed, robot.output.changed, chat.message.created, chat.conversation.created, chat.conversation.assigned, chat.conversation.tagged, chat.conversation.resolved, chat.csat.submitted. Link events can be limited to some links, tags or domains. link.updated carries the link and the list of changed fields; link.deleted, the link as it was. Each request carries Zerosoft-Signature: t=TIMESTAMP,v1=HEX, where v1 = HMAC-SHA256(secret, "TIMESTAMP.RAW_BODY"). Reject old timestamps. Failed deliveries are retried with backoff for ~15 hours.
docs.webhooksPayloadDesc: What your endpoint receives. Respond 2xx within 8 seconds.
docs.paramCalQuery: Searches the guest's name or email.
docs.paramCalEventTypeId: Event type id (from List event types).
docs.paramCalStart: Slot start, must match an offered slot.
docs.paramCalEmail: Guest email: receives the confirmation and calendar invite.
docs.paramCalTimezone: Guest timezone for the emails. Defaults to UTC.
docs.paramCalReason: Shown to the guest in the cancellation email.
docs.contactsDeleteDesc: Permanently deletes the contact. Its activities stay, unlinked.
docs.companiesDeleteDesc: Permanently deletes the company. Contacts keep existing without a company.
docs.dealsMoveTitle: Move a deal to a stage
docs.dealsMoveDesc: Moves the deal to another stage of its pipeline. Won/lost stages close it; a lost stage needs lostReason. If the stage requires properties the deal lacks, it answers 422 missing_required with the list; send them in fields to fill them in and move in one call. Fires deal.stage_changed (and deal.won / deal.lost).
docs.crmActivitiesDesc: The timeline of a contact, company or deal: notes, calls, meetings, emails and tasks. Meetings booked in Cal show up here automatically.
docs.activitiesListDesc: Most recent first. Pass exactly one of contactId, companyId or dealId.
docs.activitiesCreateDesc: Log a note, call, meeting or email on a record. Tasks have their own endpoint.
docs.paramContactIds: IDs of the contacts to enroll (1–500).
docs.paramLostReason: Why it was lost (required for lost stages).
docs.paramRecordFilter: The record whose timeline you want.
docs.paramActivityBody: Free text: notes, call summary, email body.
docs.crmEmailDesc: Shared email templates and snippets, and multi-step sales sequences. Sequence emails are sent from the sender's connected Gmail; steps run on the hourly scheduler.
docs.emailTemplatesListDesc: Templates and snippets shared in the workspace. Variables go between double curly braces (contact.first_name, contact.company, deal.name, owner.first_name, contact.custom.x), with an optional fallback after a pipe.
docs.sequencesListDesc: Sequences with their number of steps and enrollments.
docs.sequencesEnrollDesc: Enrolls up to 500 contacts. Contacts that are already enrolled, unsubscribed or without email are returned in skipped. The sender needs Gmail connected with send permission.
docs.sequencesUnenrollDesc: Removes the contact from the sequence (status exited, reason manual).
docs.paramTemplateKind: Filter by kind: template or snippet.
docs.paramSenderId: Workspace member whose Gmail sends the emails. Defaults to the contact owner, then the sequence creator.
docs.crmProductsDesc: Product catalog and the line items of each deal. While a deal has line items, its amount is the sum of their net totals (after discount, before tax) unless amountOverride is on.
docs.crmQuotesDesc: Quotes created from a deal's line items. Each quote keeps a snapshot of the items and has a public page (public_url) where the customer accepts or declines. Accepting fires the Flow event quote.accepted and the quote_accepted workflow trigger.
docs.crmAssociationsDesc: Many-to-many links between contacts, companies and deals. A contact or deal can have several companies; one of them is primary. contact.company_id always mirrors the primary company.
docs.crmTagsDesc: Workspace tags for contacts, companies and deals.
docs.productsListDesc: Products in the catalog, active first, sorted by name.
docs.productsCreateDesc: Adds a product to the catalog. Without currency it uses the workspace base currency.
docs.productsPatchDesc: Updates the fields you send. Line items already on deals don't change.
docs.productsDeleteDesc: Deletes the product. Line items that used it stay on their deals as custom items.
docs.lineItemsListDesc: Line items with their computed subtotal, discount, net, tax and total, plus the deal totals. Amounts are rounded per line to the deal currency.
docs.lineItemsCreateDesc: From a product (copies name, price, tax and recurrence; the price is converted to the deal currency when there is an exchange rate) or custom (name and unitPrice). Recalculates the deal amount.
docs.lineItemsPatchDesc: Updates quantity, price, discount, tax or text and recalculates the deal amount.
docs.lineItemsDeleteDesc: Removes the line item and recalculates the deal amount.
docs.quotesListDesc: Quotes of the workspace, newest first. Sent quotes past their expiration date are returned as expired.
docs.quotesCreateDesc: Creates a draft quote from the deal's current line items (the deal needs at least one). Defaults: expires in 30 days, recipient = first contact and primary company of the deal.
docs.quotesGetDesc: Returns the quote with its items and public_url.
docs.quotesPatchDesc: Edits a draft. status: "sent" publishes the public link (draft → sent). Accepting and declining happen on the public page. Non-draft quotes answer 409 not_draft.
docs.associationsListDesc: All records linked to a contact, company or deal. Companies also return their parent and child companies.
docs.associationsCreateDesc: Links contact ↔ company, deal ↔ company or deal ↔ contact (in either order). primary makes the company the primary one; label only applies to contact ↔ company. Linking an existing association updates its primary flag and label.
docs.associationsDeleteDesc: Unlinks two records (query parameters). Removing the primary company promotes the oldest remaining one.
docs.tagsListDesc: Tags with how many contacts, companies and deals use each one.
docs.tagsCreateDesc: Names are unique per workspace (case-insensitive). A duplicate answers 409 duplicate_tag.
docs.tagsPatchDesc: Renames the tag or changes its color.
docs.tagsDeleteDesc: Deletes the tag and removes it from every record.
docs.tagsRecordsDesc: Adds or removes the tag on up to 1000 records. Ids from other workspaces are ignored. Returns how many records changed.
docs.paramParentCompanyId: Parent company id (hierarchy). null makes it top-level. A company can't be its own ancestor.
docs.paramPrimaryCompanyId: Primary company id. It's associated if needed; the previous primary stays associated. null removes the primary.
docs.paramDealCompanyIds: Other companies to associate with the deal.
docs.paramAmountOverride: true keeps a manual amount even with line items; false recalculates it from the line items. Editing amount on a deal with line items turns it on.
docs.paramProductActiveFilter: true = active only, false = archived only.
docs.paramProductDescription: Description shown on line items and quotes.
docs.paramProductCurrency: ISO currency code (defaults to the workspace base currency).
docs.paramProductActive: false archives the product (hidden from pickers).
docs.paramRecurring: Billing interval: none, monthly or yearly.
docs.paramLineProductId: Catalog product id. Omit it for a custom line item.
docs.paramLineName: Line item name (required for custom items).
docs.paramUnitPrice: Unit price in the deal currency.
docs.paramQuoteDealId: Deal whose line items become the quote.
docs.paramQuoteTitle: Quote title (defaults to the deal name).
docs.paramQuoteSender: Sender details shown on the quote.
docs.paramQuoteRecipient: Recipient details (default: the deal's first contact and primary company).
docs.paramQuoteRefresh: Re-snapshot the deal's current line items (drafts only).
docs.paramAssocType: Record type: contact, company or deal.
docs.paramAssocPrimary: Make this the primary company of the contact or deal.
docs.paramAssocLabel: Contact ↔ company label: employee, decision_maker, billing, champion, influencer, former_employee (or empty).
docs.paramTagColor: Color: crm, link, cal, track, chat, docs, flow, agents, notes, board or robots.
docs.paramTagEntity: Record type: contact, company or deal.
docs.scopesIntro: Every key has scopes, chosen when you create it. Write scopes include read. Keys created before scopes existed have all of them. A request without the needed scope gets 403 insufficient_scope.
docs.scopesVisibility: A key acts as the person who created it: if your workspace limits members to their own (or their team’s) CRM records, the API returns only those records.
docs.scope_crm_read: Read contacts, companies, deals, activities, tasks, pipelines, products, quotes, tags, templates, sequences and forms.
docs.scope_crm_write: Create, update and delete CRM records, enroll in sequences, tag records (includes crm:read).
docs.scope_links_read: List links and read their stats.
docs.scope_links_write: Create, update and delete short links (includes links:read).
docs.scope_agents_run: Send messages to your AI agents.
docs.scope_robots_run: List and run robots, read their runs and batches.
docs.crmFormsDesc: Lead capture forms and their submissions. Each submission also creates or updates a contact and logs a "Form submitted" activity.
docs.formsListDesc: All forms in the workspace with their fields, status and submission count. `key` is the public slug (or token) used in /f/'<key>' and the embed script.
docs.formsSubmissionsDesc: Submissions of a form, newest first, with the submitted values, UTM parameters and the linked contact.
docs.paramLinkForwardParams: Pass the query string of the short link to the destination (default true). On a conflict the short link value wins; qr is never passed.
docs.paramLinkExpiredUrl: Where the link redirects once it expires or reaches max_clicks. null clears it and the domain default or the zerosoft page is used.
docs.paramLinkUtm: Sets that utm_* parameter in the destination URL. An empty string or null removes it. The utm object of the link always mirrors the final URL.
docs.paramLinkDomain: Hostname of one of your verified custom domains. Leave it out to use the default domain.
docs.paramLinkExpiresAt: ISO 8601 date. After it, the link redirects to expiredUrl or shows the expired page.
docs.paramLinkMaxClicks: Clicks allowed before the link stops redirecting.
docs.paramLinkPassword: Visitors must type it before the redirect. It is stored hashed and never returned; the response only says has_password.
docs.paramLinkOg: Title, description and image (http(s) URL) for the preview in social networks and chat apps.
docs.paramLinkExternalId: Your own id for the link, unique per workspace (letters, digits and . _ : @ -). Read or update the link later with /api/v1/links/ext_{externalId}.
docs.paramLinkCreator: Only links created by this user id.
docs.paramMoveFields: Properties the stage requires, saved before moving: amount, closeDate, ownerId, priority, source, description and custom (custom field values by name).
docs.chatDesc: Read and answer the conversations of your Chat inbox from your own app or helpdesk. Needs the chat:read scope to read and chat:write to reply, assign and resolve. Replies are sent as the person who created the key.
docs.chatListDesc: Conversations of the workspace's widgets, most recently updated first.
docs.chatGetDesc: The conversation and all its messages, oldest first. Internal notes come with isNote: true.
docs.chatReplyDesc: Sends a message to the visitor (or an internal note with note: true). Like a reply from the inbox, it counts as the first response for the SLA and reopens the conversation if it was resolved. Fires chat.message.created.
docs.chatAssignDesc: Assigns the conversation to an agent of its widget, or unassigns it with null. Fires chat.conversation.assigned. Errors: 400 invalid_assignee.
docs.chatResolveDesc: Marks the conversation as resolved. If the widget has required attributes still empty, it answers 400 missing_attributes. Fires chat.conversation.resolved.
docs.chatReopenDesc: Opens a resolved or snoozed conversation again.
docs.paramChatAssignedTo: Only conversations assigned to this user id, or unassigned.
docs.paramChatLimit: How many to return (1 to 200, default 50).
docs.paramChatOffset: How many to skip, for paging.
docs.paramChatNote: true to leave an internal note the visitor doesn't see.
docs.paramChatAssignee: User id of the agent, or null to unassign.
docs.scope_chat_read: List Chat conversations and read their messages.
docs.scope_chat_write: Reply, assign, resolve and reopen Chat conversations (includes chat:read).
docs.webhooksChatDesc: Chat events carry the conversation. chat.message.created adds the message (visitor, teammate or bot; internal notes are not sent) and chat.conversation.assigned adds previousAssignedTo.
docs.groupsDesc: Read WhatsApp chats and groups, send messages and create tickets from your own systems. Messages go out from the number the chat belongs to.
docs.groupsChatsListDesc: Open chats and groups, most recent first, with labels, assignee and whether they wait for a reply.
docs.groupsMessagesListDesc: Messages and internal notes of a chat, oldest first.
docs.groupsMessagesSendDesc: Sends a WhatsApp message to the chat or group, or saves an internal note with note: true.
docs.groupsTicketsListDesc: Tickets created from WhatsApp messages, with SLA status.
docs.groupsTicketsCreateDesc: Creates a ticket on a chat. With messageId, a message has at most one ticket: repeating returns the existing one.
docs.paramGroupsFilter: all, unread, unanswered, flagged, mine, unassigned or closed
docs.paramGroupsAfter: Only messages after this ISO date
docs.paramGroupsNote: Save as an internal note instead of sending
docs.paramGroupsStatus: active (default), all, open, in_progress, resolved or closed
docs.paramGroupsTitle: Ticket title (default: the first line of the message)
docs.groupsChatGetDesc: A chat or group with its labels, assignee and members.
docs.groupsChatUpdateDesc: Assign, close or reopen, replace labels, rename (also in WhatsApp for groups) or set properties. Changes go to the audit log.
docs.groupsMembersListDesc: Members of a group with their role (member, admin or superadmin).
docs.groupsMembersUpdateDesc: Changes members in WhatsApp (WAHA or Evolution numbers). With action invite it returns the invite link; revoke: true makes a new one.
docs.groupsCreateDesc: Creates one WhatsApp group, or up to 50 with groups: [...]. Phones that WhatsApp could not add come back in notAdded.
docs.groupsNumbersListDesc: Connected WhatsApp numbers with provider, status and capabilities. Credentials are never returned.
docs.groupsLabelsListDesc: Labels of the workspace with how many chats have each one.
docs.groupsLabelsCreateDesc: Colors: gray, red, orange, yellow, green, teal, blue, purple or pink.
docs.groupsTicketGetDesc: The ticket with its linked Freshdesk or Zoho Desk tickets, if any.
docs.groupsTicketUpdateDesc: Status, priority, assignee or title. The new status is sent to linked Freshdesk or Zoho Desk tickets.
docs.groupsBroadcastsCreateDesc: Sends a message or a poll to many chats and groups from one number, at the pace you set (perMinute). With scheduledAt it goes out later.
docs.groupsRecurringCreateDesc: Repeats a message or poll daily, weekly, monthly or with a cron expression. GET the same path lists them with their next run.
docs.groupsMcpDesc: Model Context Protocol over streamable HTTP (JSON-RPC). Methods: initialize, tools/list, tools/call. Tools: list_chats, get_messages, send_message, send_poll, update_chat, list_labels, create_ticket, list_tickets, update_ticket. Write tools need groups:write.
docs.paramGroupsAssignedTo: User id of a workspace person, or null to unassign
docs.paramGroupsMemberAction: What to do with the phones
docs.paramGroupsNumberId: Number that creates the group (WAHA or Evolution)
docs.paramGroupsPoll: Object with question, options (2 to 12) and multi, instead of body. WAHA and Evolution only
docs.paramGroupsMedia: Object with url (public https), mimetype and filename
docs.paramGroupsRule: Object with freq (daily, weekly, monthly or cron), time (HH:MM), days (0 to 6), dayOfMonth or cron
docs.scope_groups_read: Read WhatsApp chats, messages and tickets in Groups.
docs.scope_groups_write: Send WhatsApp messages and create tickets in Groups.
docs.scope_track_read: Read Track issues and customer requests.
docs.scope_track_write: Create Track issues from customer requests (email, forms, Flow).
docs.crmLeadsDesc: Leads are prospects before they become a deal: owner, stage of the lead pipeline, contact and company. Converting a lead creates a deal from the app. Custom fields of leads go in custom; fields a key cannot edit return 403 field_readonly and hidden fields are left out of responses.
docs.crmObjectsDesc: Records of the custom objects an admin defined (for example vehicles or properties). Each record has a name (the primary property), an owner and its properties in custom. Field permissions apply as in contacts.
docs.leadsListDesc: Leads visible to the key, newest first.
docs.leadsCreateDesc: Needs a name, a contact or a company. Without a name it takes the contact name (or the company name). Without stageId it starts in the first open stage.
docs.leadsGetDesc: A lead with its stage, contact, company and deal.
docs.leadsPatchDesc: Change the stage, owner, contact, company, source, disqualify reason or custom fields.
docs.leadsDeleteDesc: Deletes the lead and its notes and tasks. The contact, company and deal stay.
docs.objectsListDesc: Objects of the workspace with the properties the key can see.
docs.objectRecordsListDesc: Records of an object, newest first.
docs.objectRecordsCreateDesc: Values in custom are checked against the type of each property; unknown properties are ignored.
docs.objectRecordsGetDesc: The record with the ids of its associated contacts, companies and deals.
docs.objectRecordsPatchDesc: Change the name, owner or properties.
docs.objectRecordsDeleteDesc: Deletes the record with its notes and tasks.
docs.paramLeadStatus: Only leads in stages of this type.
docs.paramLeadOwner: Workspace member who owns it. Defaults to the key creator.
docs.paramLeadSource: Source (organic, referral, ads, social, email, event, form, other).
docs.extensionSidebarTitle: Contact panel for an email address
docs.extensionSidebarDesc: What the Gmail extension shows next to an email: the contact with that address, its company, deals and open tasks. contact is null if nobody in the CRM you can see has it.
docs.extensionLogDesc: Saves an email in the timeline of the contacts who take part in it. Sending the same messageId again does not duplicate it (200 with duplicate: true). 404 no_contact if no participant is a contact.
docs.extensionTrackTitle: Log and track an email before sending
docs.extensionTrackDesc: Saves the outgoing email and returns the open tracking pixel to add to its body. If no recipient is a contact, the first one is created as a contact.
docs.voiceDesc: Dictation and meeting transcripts. The desktop app uses these endpoints with a key that has voice:read and voice:write. Audio is transcribed and discarded.
docs.voiceDictateDesc: Multipart upload of an audio clip. Returns the transcript cleaned up with the person's dictionary and style, and saves it in their dictation history.
docs.voiceSessionsListDesc: Dictations and meetings of the person who created the key, newest first.
docs.voiceSessionsCreateDesc: Starts a meeting to upload audio chunks to.
docs.voiceChunksDesc: Transcribes one chunk of a meeting. source is me (microphone), them (system audio) or mixed. Idempotent by source and seq.
docs.voiceSessionGetDesc: The session with its transcript, notes and AI notes.
docs.voiceSessionPatchDesc: Rename it, or set status to done when the recording ends.
docs.voiceDictionaryDesc: Words, replacements, snippets and dictation settings of the person, to sync the desktop app.
docs.scope_voice_read: Read Voice dictations, meetings and transcripts.
docs.scope_voice_write: Dictate and upload meeting audio to Voice.
docs.trackDesc: Issues, comments, teams, cycles, statuses, labels and people of Track. Use a key with track:read or track:write. Issues created by API go to triage when the team has it on, and every change leaves activity, notifications, webhooks and an audit entry like the app. Teams were called projects before: /api/v1/track/projects and projectId still work.
docs.trackMcpDesc: Model Context Protocol over Streamable HTTP at /api/mcp/track (read-only at /api/mcp/track/readonly). Authenticate with an API key as Bearer. Tools: search_issues, get_issue, create_issue, update_issue, add_comment, list_teams, get_team, list_cycles, list_labels, list_users.
docs.trackMcpCallDesc: JSON-RPC 2.0: initialize, tools/list and tools/call. Write tools need track:write.
docs.trackIssuesListDesc: Issues the key can see, most recently updated first, with filters.
docs.trackIssuesCreateDesc: teamId accepts the id or the key (WEB); projectId is the older name. status accepts a status name or a category. Links to Sentry, Zendesk, Intercom or Figma stay linked to the issue.
docs.trackIssuesUpdateDesc: Send only what changes. Changing status or assignee accepts an issue waiting in triage.
docs.trackIssuesDeleteDesc: Deletes the issue and its sub-issues.
docs.trackCommentsListDesc: Comments of an issue, oldest first.
docs.trackCommentsCreateDesc: Comments as the key owner in markdown and notifies subscribers and mentions.
docs.trackProjectsListDesc: Active teams the key can see. includeArchived=true adds archived ones.
docs.trackProjectsCreateDesc: Admins only. Creates the default statuses. key is the identifier prefix.
docs.trackProjectsGetDesc: By id or key, with its statuses.
docs.trackProjectsUpdateDesc: Name, description, color and icon. Archiving and triage need an admin key.
docs.trackStatusesDesc: Workflow statuses of a team in order, with their category.
docs.trackLabelsDesc: Workspace labels. POST with name and teamId creates one.
docs.trackUsersDesc: People who can be assigned, of one team or all.
docs.paramTrackProjectId: Team id or key (WEB). projectId also works.
docs.paramTrackUpdatedSince: Only issues updated since this ISO date.
docs.paramTrackLabels: Label names; missing ones are created.
docs.paramTrackLinks: Sentry, Zendesk, Intercom or Figma URLs to link.
docs.webhooksTrackDesc: issue.* events carry the issue and its team (project in the payload); issue.status_changed adds from and to, comment.created the comment and project.* the team.
docs.talkDesc: Team messaging. The key acts as the person who created it: it sees the channels that person sees and posts where that person is a member (joining public channels on the first post). Direct messages are not available through the API. Scopes talk:read and talk:write.
docs.talkChannelsListDesc: Channels the key person is in, or with scope=all the public channels and the private ones they are in.
docs.talkChannelsCreateDesc: Creates a public or private channel. The name is stored like Slack: lowercase, with hyphens instead of spaces.
docs.talkMessagesListDesc: Channel level messages, newest last. Mentions come as tokens with the user id, plus channel and here tokens.
docs.talkMessagesSendDesc: Posts in a channel or replies in a thread. Mentions, notifications, link previews, Flow and webhooks run as if it were sent from the app.
docs.talkHookDesc: Without an API key: create the URL in a channel (Details, Integrations) and POST JSON with text. It posts as a bot with the webhook name. 60 requests per minute per webhook.
docs.paramTalkBefore: ISO date: messages before it (for paging)
docs.paramTalkText: Message text, with the same formatting as the app (*bold*, _italic_, `code`, links, :emoji:)
docs.paramTalkThread: Id of the root message to reply in its thread
docs.paramTalkAlso: With thread_id, also show the reply in the channel
docs.paramTalkUsername: Bot name shown on the message (by default, the webhook name)
docs.scope_talk_read: Read Talk channels and messages you are a member of.
docs.scope_talk_write: Post Talk messages and create channels.
docs.shopApiDesc: Your store’s catalog and orders. Scopes shop:read and shop:write. Customer data is only available to keys of people with the Shop app.
docs.shopProductsListDesc: Products with status, price range, variant count and stock. POST to the same path creates a product with the same body the app uses.
docs.shopOrdersListDesc: Orders newest first, with status (pending, paid, fulfilled, cancelled, refunded) and total in cents.
docs.boardsApiDesc: Whiteboards: list and search them (also by the text inside), read an outline, create them from a template, add stickies, shapes and arrows, rename, move to a folder or send to the trash. The key acts as the person who created it: it sees and edits the boards that person can open. People with the board open see the changes live. Scopes boards:read and boards:write.
docs.boardsListDesc: Boards the key person can open, most recently edited first. With q it also searches stickies, labels and frame names, and returns the matching line in match.
docs.boardsCreateDesc: Empty or from a template: retro, brainstorm, userFlow, kanban, roadmap, swot, mindMap, priorityMatrix, journey or leanCanvas.
docs.boardsGetDesc: The board with an outline: frames in reading order, stickies with text and tags, loose texts. With scene=1, also the Excalidraw scene.
docs.boardsUpdateDesc: Renames the board or moves it to a folder (folderId null takes it out).
docs.boardsDeleteDesc: Moves the board to the trash. It can be restored from the app for 30 days.
docs.boardsElementsDesc: Adds stickies, texts and shapes, and arrows between them by index. Without x and y they are laid out next to the existing content. Nothing already on the board is changed.
docs.boardsMcpDesc: Model Context Protocol (streamable HTTP, JSON responses) for AI agents. Tools: list_boards, get_board, create_board, add_stickies, add_diagram, update_board and trash_board.
docs.paramBoardsQuery: Search the name and the text inside the board.
docs.paramBoardsScene: Use 1 to include the Excalidraw scene.
docs.paramBoardsStickies: Sticky notes: { text, color?, tags? }. Colors: yellow, green, blue, pink, violet, orange.
docs.paramBoardsElements: Shapes and texts: { kind, text?, x?, y?, width?, height?, fill? } with kind sticky, text, rectangle, ellipse or diamond.
docs.paramBoardsConnect: Arrows between elements by index: { from, to }.
docs.scope_boards_read: Read boards, their outline and search inside them.
docs.scope_boards_write: Create boards, add stickies and shapes, rename, move and trash them.
docs.docsApiDesc: Read and write Docs pages, blocks, databases, rows and comments. Content goes in and out as Markdown (or Docs blocks). A key acts as the person who created it: it only sees and edits the pages that person can open. Synced databases are read-only.
docs.docsPagesListDesc: Pages the key can read, newest first. With q it searches titles and content.
docs.docsPagesCreateDesc: Creates a page from Markdown or blocks, inside another page (parentId) or from a template (a workspace template id or builtin:<key>). Template {{variables}} are filled from vars.
docs.docsPagesGetDesc: The page with its content as Markdown and its databases. format=blocks also returns the blocks.
docs.docsPagesUpdateDesc: Changes the title or icon, replaces the content (databases on the page are kept) or moves it to the trash and back (archived).
docs.docsPagesDeleteTitle: Move a page to the trash
docs.docsPagesDeleteDesc: Moves the page and its subpages to the trash. Restore it with PATCH archived: false.
docs.docsBlocksListDesc: The blocks of a page in Docs format (type, content as HTML-lite, nesting with indent).
docs.docsBlocksAppendDesc: Adds Markdown or blocks at the end of the page, or below the block in after. People with the page open see it merged into their editor.
docs.docsCommentsListDesc: Comments and threads of a page.
docs.docsCommentsCreateDesc: Comments on the page or a block, or replies to a thread, as the person who created the key.
docs.docsDatabasesListDesc: Databases on the pages the key can read, with their properties and options.
docs.docsDatabaseGetDesc: Properties of a database and, for synced databases, where they come from.
docs.docsRowsListDesc: Rows of a database with their properties as text (properties) and raw values (values). filter[Property]=text keeps the rows whose value contains it.
docs.docsRowsCreateDesc: Adds a row. properties maps property names (or ids) to values: select options are created if missing, people go by email, dates as YYYY-MM-DD. Database automations run as usual.
docs.docsRowsGetDesc: One row with its properties and its content as Markdown.
docs.docsRowsUpdateDesc: Changes properties, the title or the content of a row.
docs.docsRowsDeleteDesc: Deletes the row. It stays in the page history.
docs.docsSearchDesc: Pages and database rows by title and content, with a snippet.
docs.docsMcpDesc: Model Context Protocol over streamable HTTP (JSON-RPC). Methods: initialize, tools/list, tools/call. Tools: search, fetch_page, create_page, update_page, list_databases, get_database, query_database, get_row, create_row, update_row, list_comments, add_comment. Write tools need docs:write.
docs.paramDocsParent: Only pages inside this page id (root for top-level pages).
docs.paramDocsMarkdown: Content in Markdown (headings, lists, to-dos, quotes, code, tables).
docs.paramDocsParentId: Create it as a subpage of this page.
docs.paramDocsFormat: blocks to also get the raw blocks.
docs.paramDocsReplace: Replaces the whole content (databases are kept).
docs.paramDocsArchived: true moves it to the trash, false restores it.
docs.paramDocsBlocks: Blocks in Docs format (instead of Markdown).
docs.paramDocsCommentParent: Reply in the thread of this comment.
docs.paramDocsFilter: Keep rows whose Property contains the text.
docs.paramDocsRowTemplate: Row template of the database (id or name).
docs.paramDocsRowAppend: Markdown to add at the end of the row content.
docs.scope_docs_read: Read Docs pages, databases, rows and comments, and search.
docs.scope_docs_write: Create and edit Docs pages, rows and comments (includes docs:read).
docs.paramDocsLimit: How many to return (1 to 100, default 50).
docs.paramDocsOffset: How many to skip, to page through results.
docs.linksTrackLeadDesc: Attributes a sign-up to the click that brought the visitor. The link needs conversion tracking on: its visits reach your site with ?zs_id=<clickId> (the /link-tracking.js script keeps it in a zs_id cookie on your domain). The same customer and event name only count once.
docs.linksTrackSaleDesc: Records revenue for the link that brought the customer: by customerExternalId (a lead tracked before) or by clickId for a direct sale. Amounts go in minor units. A repeated invoiceId returns duplicate: true and does not count twice.
docs.linksTrackOpenDesc: Called by your mobile app on its first open with the workspace publishable key (Authorization: Bearer zs_pk_…, in Link settings › Conversions), never with an API key. It returns the link of this workspace tapped in the last hour from the same network and platform (matched by a salted hash, used once), or resolves deepLink if the app was opened with one of your short links. Password-protected links come back without destination; archived, expired, blocked or exhausted links are a 404.
docs.linksMcpDesc: Model Context Protocol server (streamable HTTP, JSON responses) for AI agents. Tools: list_links, get_link, create_link, update_link, delete_link, get_link_analytics, get_analytics, list_conversions and list_activity. links:read reads, links:write creates and edits. The key acts as the person who created it, folder permissions included.
docs.paramClickId: Click id that reached your site as ?zs_id= (20 letters and numbers).
docs.paramCustomerExternalId: Your own id for the customer. Sales tracked later with this id go to the same link.
docs.paramEventName: Event name, such as Sign up or Purchase.
docs.paramCustomerName: Customer name (optional, only visible to your workspace).
docs.paramCustomerEmail: Customer email (optional, only visible to your workspace).
docs.paramInvoiceId: Payment or invoice id, so the same sale never counts twice.
docs.paramDeferredDomain: Hostname of your custom domain, to only match links of that domain.
docs.paramDeepLink: Short link the app was opened with (universal link or app link), if any.
docs.designApiDesc: Read the designs the key’s person can see: names, sizes, pages and, with id, the full JSON of the pages.
docs.designListDesc: Without id, the designs the person can see (most recent first). With id, that design with its pages in JSON.
docs.paramDesignView: recent (default), mine, shared, starred or templates
docs.paramDesignId: A design id: returns that design with its pages
docs.scope_design_read: Read Design designs and their pages.
docs.analyticsApiDesc: Product analytics. The ingest endpoints (/api/ingest/*) take the project key, not an API key: the public key (zsp_…) in the body from a browser, or the project secret key as Bearer zss_… from a server. Query endpoints accept a signed-in session or an API key with analytics:read.
docs.analyticsCaptureDesc: One event or a batch of up to 200, 512 KB per request. With the secret key as Bearer there is no origin check. Events with a repeated uuid are ignored. Rate limited per project.
docs.analyticsDecideDesc: Values of the active flags for a distinct_id (true, false or the variant key) and the snippet settings. person_properties is added to what the person already has.
docs.analyticsDeleteDesc: Deletes the person behind a distinct_id with all their events and sessions. Needs the project secret key as Bearer zss_….
docs.analyticsQueryDesc: kind is trends, funnel, retention, paths, sql or web. SQL is read-only over the project tables events, persons, person_distinct_ids and sessions, up to 1,000 rows.
docs.analyticsEventsDesc: Latest events of a project, newest first. Pass after with the last id you saw to get only new ones.
docs.analyticsPersonsDesc: Persons of a project with their properties and distinct ids, most recently seen first.
docs.paramAnalyticsApiKey: Project public key (zsp_…). Also accepted as token.
docs.paramAnalyticsBatch: Events: event, distinct_id, properties, timestamp and an optional uuid. A single event can go at the top level instead.
docs.paramAnalyticsSentAt: When the client sent the batch; used to correct its clock.
docs.paramAnalyticsDistinctId: The id of the person in your product.
docs.paramAnalyticsPersonProps: Extra person properties for this evaluation.
docs.paramAnalyticsQuery: The query definition, the same one the app saves for an insight.
docs.paramAnalyticsAfter: Only events with a larger id.
docs.paramAnalyticsCohort: Only persons in this cohort id.
docs.scope_analytics_read: Read Analytics projects, events, persons and run queries.
docs.scope_analytics_write: Change Analytics projects, insights, dashboards, cohorts and flags.
docs.scope_social_read: Read Social posts on the accounts you can see.
docs.scope_social_write: Create Social drafts and scheduled posts (with approval if you need it).
docs.socialApiDesc: Social media posts. The key acts as the person who created it: it sees and posts to that person's accounts, and people who need approval send posts for approval. Scopes social:read and social:write.
docs.socialPostsListDesc: Posts the key can see, newest first, with each account's status and the link to the published post.
docs.socialPostsCreateDesc: Saves a draft, schedules it, adds it to the queue or publishes it now. Each network checks length and media first; errors come back per account.
docs.paramSocialStatus: draft, pending_approval, scheduled, published, partial or failed.
docs.paramSocialAccounts: Ids of the connected accounts to post to.
docs.paramSocialOverrides: Own text per account: { accountId: text }.
docs.paramSocialAction: draft, schedule, queue or now. Default draft.
docs.paramSocialScheduledAt: Date and time to publish (ISO 8601), with action schedule.
docs.scope_books_read: Read Books invoices (with the Books role of the person who created the key).
docs.booksApiDesc: Invoices from Books. The key acts as the person who created it, with that person’s Books role. Amounts are integers in the currency’s minor unit (cents). Scopes books:read and books:write.
docs.booksInvoicesListDesc: Invoices, newest first, with status, number, customer, total and amount due.
docs.booksInvoicesCreateDesc: Saves a draft with the same body the app uses. Someone approves it in the app, which assigns the number and posts the journal.
docs.paramBooksStatus: draft, sent, partial, paid, overdue, void, or open (anything still due).
docs.paramBooksContact: Books contact id of the customer.
docs.paramBooksLines: Lines: description, quantity, unitPrice (integer minor units, or a decimal string with a dot as the decimal separator, e.g. "1500.50", whatever the currency), discountBps, taxRateId, itemId.
docs.paramBooksCurrency: ISO currency code; the base currency if omitted.
docs.paramBooksFx: Manual exchange rate (base currency per 1 unit) when the currency is not the base one.

parityOverview.title: Feature parity, app by app.
parityOverview.lead: Average parity across the 20 apps: {average}%. We compare {counted} capabilities of the tool each app replaces.
parityOverview.method: Each app counts 1 for an included capability, 0.5 for a partial one and 0 for a missing one, with double weight for core capabilities. It is our own review against the code, updated with every release. Open an app to see its full list.

desktopLogin.confirm: The zerosoft app on {device} will sign in as {email}.
desktopLogin.notYou: If you didn't start this from the zerosoft app, close this tab.

desktopLogin.close: You can close this tab once the app opens.

meta.title: Download zerosoft for Mac and Windows
meta.description: The desktop app: every zerosoft app in one window, dictation in any app and meeting notes with system audio. Also on your phone as an installable web app.

download.title: zerosoft for your computer.
download.sub: Every app in one window, plus what a browser tab cannot do: dictation in any app and meeting notes with your computer audio.
download.otherMac: Mac with an Intel chip? Download the Intel version.
download.otherArm: Mac with Apple silicon? Download the Apple silicon version.
download.noRelease: There is no published build yet. You can build it from the source in desktop/ (the README explains how).
download.unsignedTitle: The builds are not signed yet
download.unsignedMac: On Mac: open the .dmg and drag zerosoft to Applications. The first time, macOS blocks it because it is not notarized yet: on macOS 15 or later go to System Settings › Privacy & Security and click Open Anyway; on macOS 14 or earlier, right-click the app and choose Open.
download.unsignedWin: On Windows: SmartScreen may say it protected your PC. Click More info, then Run anyway.
download.unsignedUpdates: Automatic updates on Mac need a signed build. Until then, download new versions from this page.
download.f1d: Hold Control + Option on Mac or Ctrl + Windows on Windows, speak, and let go. The clean text is pasted where your cursor is, with your Voice dictionary and style.
download.f2d: When a calendar meeting starts, or Zoom, Meet or Teams is in a call, zerosoft offers to take notes. It records your mic and the system audio, and the notes land in Voice.
download.f3d: Unread mentions and direct messages on the dock or taskbar icon, and system notifications that open the right page.
download.f4t: Sign in with Google in your browser
download.f4d: The app sends you to your browser to sign in and comes back on its own. It also works with your own server if you self-host.
download.reqMac: macOS 12 or later. System audio in meetings needs macOS 13 or later.
download.mobileBody: Open zerosoft.ai/app in Safari or Chrome and add it to the home screen: it opens like an app, with every zerosoft app. Native iOS and Android builds are not in the stores yet.
